labels.label: L1
labels.receiver: thread::spawn(move || { let ga = ma.lock().unwrap(); // s1: lock mtx_a let gb = mb.lock().unwrap(); // s2: lock mtx_b drop(gb); // s3 drop(ga); // s4 })

labels.label: L4
labels.receiver: thread::spawn(move || { let ga = ma2.lock().unwrap(); // s1: lock mtx_a (same order) let gb = mb2.lock().unwrap(); // s2: lock mtx_b drop(gb); // s3 drop(ga); // s4 })

labels.label: L7
labels.receiver: thread::spawn(move || loop { thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)); // s1/s2: nop loop })
